notes:
• New: Watch provider (Settings › Accounts) — ValFlix on this device, Trakt, Simkl, MDBList or PunchPlay drives check marks, resume points, Next Episode and your rows. What you watch goes to that provider
• Simkl rebuilt with its new sign-in (anime episodes map to Simkl's numbering); MDBList signs in with a code/QR and adds history, progress, watchlist, lists and IMDb/RT/Metacritic/Letterboxd ratings; new PunchPlay support
• Add to list shows every account's watchlist and lists; Search finds your own lists and public Trakt/MDBList lists; each account's rows can be added under Appearance › Rows
• Trakt: your whole watch history loads, not just the first 100 movies
• Rewatching: something watched before now offers Resume when you stopped partway
• Subtitle search in the player (Audio & Subtitles › Search subtitles…) from OpenSubtitles: your languages first, then ones made for your exact file and frame rate. Optional Auto-fetch setting and OpenSubtitles sign-in
• New Info button in the player: full details on the file, video, HDR, audio, decoders, display and buffer
• Audio: plays the file's default track in your language instead of the highest bitrate one, and Atmos is sent as plain DD+ (fixes silent audio on some soundbars and TVs)
• Trailers download a piece at a time, so they no longer stall partway
• TV: typing a key opens the keyboard on OK
